top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalysed C-N cross-coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig) is the most mature and cleanly attributable achievement on the slate: about thirty years of independent confirmation, a defined mechanism with a distinct bond class and rate-limiting step from the 2010 C-C coupling prize, ligand generations developed by two groups, and routine use in medicinal-chemistry and process routes. A citation limited to general catalytic C-N coupling matches the two-name credit; the Kosugi precursor is a non-general, stoichiometric-tin-amide antecedent that can be handled in the background text. PROTACs come next for a real chemical design principle, then nitrogenase for mature, reproduced structural work, with phase separation ranked lowest among awards because the in vivo claims remain unsettled.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; shared Lund affiliation with Linke and Sparr bears on no proposal, and no recorded tie to any laureate on the slate
